verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas engine is open source and public on GitHub (playcanvas/engine), and its npm package is an MIT-licensed runtime, so developers can read and modify the full engine source. Independent community comments corroborate that it is open source. Missing for 10: first-party docs on building, forking or patching the engine from source, and evidence on whether the cloud Editor's source is also available.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall

citations.quote: PlayCanvas is an open-source game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU.
`npm view playcanvas version` → 2.22.2 (MIT engine runtime, 48,435 weekly downloads)
PlayCanvas is an open-source 3D engine for the web, rendering with WebGL2 or WebGPU
It's an open source javascript game engine that is kinda like halfway between something like three.js and e.g. Unity
